1879064075.Skill_Desc: Increases movement speed.\n\nGrants immunity to movement speed debuffs.

1879064203.Skill_Desc: Removes one Poison, Fear, Disease, or Wound from nearby fellows.\n\nProtects against further Fears.

1879064331.Skill_Desc: A Critical hit enables the Burglar to strike from an advantageous position, applying a tiering bleed to the target.

1879073675.Skill_Desc: A sweeping cut that can damage multiple targets in front of you.

1879099275.Skill_Desc: You can instruct someone how to play the horn.

1879111435.Skill_Desc: Champions shrug off damage that would bring many to their knees.

1879146123.Skill_Desc:
Creates a circle in which enemies are vulnerable to tactical damage and more likely to miss.

Circle remains for 1 minute.

Affects the following:
Dead, Unseen, Creatures of Nature, Insects and additionally affects  Men, Dwarves, Orc-kind, Beasts, and Trolls.

1879153291.Skill_Desc:
With preparation, some Wardens can throw their javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.

For every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

With the appropriate Assailment traits, this javelin will apply the Marked and Diminished Target debuffs to any targets hit.
This skill is not influenced by modifiers to Max Range.

1879190667.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter when Kindred with Thorin's Hall.

1879198347.Skill_Desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879202187.Skill_Desc: Soldiers of Minas Ithil carry packets of athelas with them for healing purposes during combat. Can be used on oneself or thrown to an ally.

1879213323.Skill_Desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879214603.Skill_Desc: A swift double attack.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879231371.Skill_Desc: Deals heavy damage and removes one corruption from the enemy.

1879238667.Skill_Desc: Your steed pushes itself beyond normal limits, maintaining an increased speed for as long as its power holds out.

1879239563.Skill_Desc: Targeting the most vital areas of an opponent is difficult enough. While mounted it takes increased skill and effort; maybe even a little patience and luck, but when you strike with this skill the results are destructive.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill has a reduced chance to hit unless the trait Shoot to Kill is active.</rgb>

1879241995.Skill_Desc: The initial impact of your weapon is meant to injure your foe, but the true damage is unleashed as you drag your weapon across your foe's flesh.

1879243915.Skill_Desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount. Your Morale will increase even if this attack is avoided.

1879248011.Skill_Desc: You quickly throw the spear in the direction of the target. It is not likely to strike.

1879260043.Skill_Desc: Your oil-soaked arrow sets your enemy aflame and causes it to burn.

1879263627.Skill_Desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879307147.Skill_Desc: Summons a plain shrew to brighten your day.
1879307147.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival by participating in the Shrew Stomp.

1879315083.Skill_Desc: You strike your opponent across the face with your paw, interrupting their action.

1879332619.Skill_Desc: Summons a horse with a jet-black coat to keep you company.
1879332619.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from participating in the story of Bingo Boffin. May be bartered for in Dunland.

1879342475.Skill_Desc: A steed evoking the beauty of the moth.
1879342475.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879344395.Skill_Desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879367947.Skill_Desc: Places a trap to root the enemy.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879387659.Skill_Desc: Brings out an orange glow worm to keep you company.
1879387659.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879387787.Skill_Desc: A steed inspired by the ancient kingdom of Khazad-dûm.
1879387787.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879391243.Skill_Desc: A steed inspired by the Wild Hills of Enedwaith.
1879391243.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879408139.Skill_Desc: Summons a purple firefly to keep you company.
1879408139.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter during the Midsummer Festival.

1879417099.Skill_Desc: Summons a Wildwood huorn so you never leave the forest behind.

1879422347.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879449995.Skill_Desc: A savage attack that leaves your target bleeding.

1879457547.Skill_Desc: A lunge which deals shorter, more potent Light damage over time.

1879463691.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879466251.Skill_Desc: Minor afflictions don't compare to eating only rations for long periods. Your strong stomach allows you to shrug off a single effect.

1879467275.Skill_Desc: You carry a caber, slowly, showing your strength as a forester.

1879468683.Skill_Desc: Summons a curious fennec fox to accompany you on your journeys.
1879468683.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Corsairs of Umbar Collector's Edition or Ultimate Fan Bundle.

1879483531.Skill_Desc: A powerful attack that can only be used on opponents under 20% health.

1879489163.Skill_Desc: Your companion throws their bulk at their target, stunning them.

1879500427.Skill_Desc:
Call upon Glorfindel to empower his Elf-stone to purge the essence of the void seeping into Middle-earth.
<rgb=#00FF00>Destroys active blisters around you.</rgb>

To use this skill, you must be near Glorfindel.

1879502731.Skill_Desc: Summons a loving but terrifying bird to accompany you on your adventures.
1879502731.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Acquired from Luxuriant, Enhanced, and Simple Patron's Coffers of the Sands.

1879506827.Skill_Desc: Smash your target as if caught between a hammer and anvil.

1879521291.Skill_Desc: Summons a desert slime to accompany you on your travels.

1879527435.Skill_Desc: Channel the power of the gem to cleanse the target of the TBD Curse. This power will also harm the user.
